citation.title: Understanding university students’ AI ethical decision-making in academic contexts: a SOR - social cognitive perspective

reading.source_scope_note: Cross-sectional Chinese undergraduate survey with rubric-scored scenario choices/justifications. N1106retained from1470;PLS-SEM,fsQCA and IPMA use the same dataset,not independent replications or identified causal interventions. Moral attentiveness/norm internalization are distinct conceptual sources within an inconsistently defined moral-cognition construct.
access_limits: All supplied pages,figures and main tables read. The cited external appendices,complete task texts,scoring keys,sample responses,full measurement items,ICC coefficient and raw data/code are not included or independently inspected.
The study reports translation/back-translation,expert review,two-rater scoring and supplementary diagnostics; those claims cannot be independently reproduced from the supplied PDF.
Bibliographic metadata and selected indexed primary summaries are narrow checks,not full readings of the original scales,books,UNESCO report or other primary studies.

study.design_and_sample: One-time questionnaire,online Wenjuanxing and offline classes,over30institutions in10Chinese provinces,hybrid stratification plus within-stratum convenience recruitment.1470responses−364exclusions=1106;about24.8%excluded. No randomized ethics course/guidance or temporal panel. Sampling diversity is not a national probability sample; university/class clustering and modes can matter.
study.outcome: Five tasks on paraphrasing/attribution,generated references,code/assignment authorship,data handling and group improper AI use. Each requires an option plus brief justification. Choice0–2+reason0–3gives raw0–5score;five task scores reflective indicators. This is scored hypothetical decision performance,not merely willingness,but not actual misconduct or real-world compliance. Two raters trained and independent before discussion;ICC promised but no coefficient appears in supplied main results. Full tasks/rubric/sample answers are externalAppendix5.
study.predictors_and_constructs: AI ethics guidance7items and course experience6items are perceived inputs,not verified system features or assigned course exposure. Cognitive complexity6items is adapted from Martin/Rubin cognitive flexibility,while theory uses differentiation/integration and cites integrative complexity. Moral cognition5items is defined as norm understanding/endorsement/internalization in theory,but methods describe moral issue recognition,sustained attention/reflection adapted from Reynolds awareness/attentiveness. These labels/scales should not be treated as interchangeable validated constructs without the full instrument.
study.screening: Listwise deletion for focal/demographic/task missingness;time<one-third sample median;20or more identical responses among24Likert items;incomplete/blank/invalid justifications excluded. No per-criterion counts supplied. The rubric allows0for missing/irrelevant reasoning but screening also excludes invalid written reasoning,so the distinction and possible outcome-related selection need clarification. Offline timing comparability is not fully specified.
study.net_effects: Standardized guidance→decision.334,course→decision.336,guidance→moral cognition.479,course→moral cognition.280,moral cognition→decision.215(allreportedp<.001). Indirects.103/.060reconcile with products. R²decision.663,cognition.464. Cognitive complexity interactions course.073,p.021 and guidance.077,p.017inTable4/prose,butFigure2prints guidance−.077. Gender/grade null;frequency/major small positive controls. Five-thousand bootstraps do not create temporal precedence or rule out confounding;authors explicitly acknowledge this.
study.measurement: Main text reports loadings.705–.792,AVE.572–.609,alpha.820–.875,CR.874–.903,maximumVIF1.998,HTMTup to.823. Full values are external appendices. Reliability/discriminant checks and full-collinearity diagnostics do not prove common-method bias absent or validate the latent construct labels. Q²values alone are not external out-of-sample validation.
study.configuration: fsQCA same1106cases;95th/50th/5thpercentile anchors,genderbinary;frequency3,consistency.80,PRI.70then>.85forinterpretability;49initialrows→36→8,5highsolutions. All high solutions show guidance/course core presence;no single necessityconsistency≥.90. This is not logically contradictory: selected sufficient coverage is not universal necessity. But Table5rawhighcoverage.877/.824/.811exceeds reportedoverall.793,and all lowrawcoverages.712/.675/.644exceedoverall.635,which cannot reconcile as standard same-outcome solution-union coverage. No corrected outputs can be recovered without data.
study.configuration_additional_scope: Table5also contains presence of guidance in two low-outcome paths,and blank/present course conditions,so low outcome is not uniformly absence of both. Data-dependent threshold raising and coding/calibration of ordinal grade or nominal majors need full supplement justification. Configurational consistency is not a causal effect estimate or proven pedagogical necessity.
study.prioritization: IPMA marks AEC3/AEC5/AEG7high modeled importance/lower score. This is a model-derived priority,not a direct survey of student-assigned importance or an evaluated resource-allocation intervention. Figure3shows scale means around3.65–3.95;no optimization trial or actual curricular benefit is demonstrated.
study.ethics_and_status: Methods describe an author-claimed review exemption and online electronic/offline verbal consent. Final boilerplate ethics statement is malformed and says written consent. Record the mismatch without making a legal or misconduct finding; no approval/exemption document is supplied. Data are2025;some cited2026publication context isnot participant exposure.
study.causal_limits: The authors explicitly state reverse/reciprocal associations and unobserved confounding remain possible. The same dataset analyzed three ways is complementary description,not triangulated causal confirmation. Practical training,prompt and differentiated-support recommendations remain untested.

summary: Add moral attentiveness and norm internalization as distinct human concepts discussed in the paper,with clear measurement/causal limits. Enrich existing integrative complexity instead of duplicating the source’s cognitive-complexity label. Record source identity,figure-sign and impossible configurational-coverage discrepancies;retain scored task outcomes without claiming actual compliance.

findings.definition: A tendency to notice moral aspects of experiences and to attend to and reflect on their ethical implications.
findings.origin: Moral psychology / ethical awareness and attention
findings.ai_evidence_status: Established human construct cited as a measurement source for the paper’s moral-cognition scale. No separately identified attentiveness effect or verified complete scale in the supplied PDF.
findings.ai_proposal: Evaluate whether an assistant notices ethically relevant consent,attribution,privacy and affected-party considerations in otherwise ordinary tasks. Vary moral salience while holding the task fixed,and assess warranted attention rather than rewarding generic moral warnings.
findings.novelty_rationale: Selective attention is general filtering; moral attentiveness concerns content-specific habitual noticing/reflection. Norm internalization concerns adopting standards as guides; a person can notice an issue without endorsing or following a norm.

evidence.quote: their sustained attention to and reflection upon ethical information
Moral attentiveness: who pays attention to the moral aspects of life?

findings.evidence_scope: Methods cite Reynolds2006/2008and describe a moral-cognition scale emphasizing recognition/attention,while theory emphasizes endorsement/internalization. Complete items and original sources are not independently read;do not attribute the entire indirect association to attentiveness alone.
findings.boundary: Noticing an ethical issue does not establish correct moral judgment,good intent or actual compliance. Greater moral attention is not automatically beneficial if it invents irrelevant issues or displaces the agreed task;models’ generated attention is not proof of subjective moral concern.

findings.definition: Adopting a norm as an internal evaluative standard that guides judgment and conduct beyond immediate external prompts or sanctions.
findings.origin: Social cognitive theory / moral learning and self-regulation
findings.ai_evidence_status: Theoretical interpretation in a cross-sectional human survey;stable internalization,transfer and persistence after prompts are not directly established. The reported moral-cognition scale also draws on awareness/attentiveness.
findings.ai_proposal: Test whether an assistant applies authorized,justified principles consistently across unfamiliar cases after explicit reminders are removed. Distinguish generalization from copying visible wording,and check whether it can question an unjust norm. Untrusted retrieved text does not gain authority by resembling an ethical instruction.
findings.novelty_rationale: Automaton conformity specifically involves losing awareness of norms’ outside origin;internalization can be reflective and justified. System justification defends an institutional arrangement’s legitimacy,whereas internalization concerns how a standard becomes a personal guide. Neither is identical to momentary awareness or public compliance.
findings.evidence_scope: The paper’s theory distinguishes internalized standards from scenario performance. Perceived inputs and the scale are simultaneous;the authors acknowledge reverse/reciprocal explanations. No longitudinal persistence,removal-of-reminder test or demonstrated acquisition process.
findings.boundary: An internalized standard need not be fair or correct,and conformity alone does not show internalization. For AI,behavioral consistency across authorized contexts is an operational analogy,not evidence of conscience,personal values or a human learning mechanism.

findings.definition: The extent to which reasoning differentiates multiple perspectives or considerations and integrates them into a coherent account.
findings.novelty_rationale: The source’s theoretical cognitive-complexity description overlaps the existing differentiation/integration concept. Do not add an ambiguous duplicate label or equate its adapted flexibility scale with a validated scored complexity measure.

evidence.quote: differentiate multiple cues, integrate diverse perspectives

findings.evidence_scope: The paper proposes complexity as a moderator and reports small positive interactions inTable4/prose. The six-item measure is adapted from cognitive flexibility;full items and construct validation remain external. Figure2has a conflicting sign for one moderator. This is relevant conceptual/context evidence,not independent validation of integrative-complexity scoring.
findings.boundary: Flexibility,complexity,cognitive load and objectively scored integration differ. Longer reasoning,more mentioned perspectives or a positive self-rating need not demonstrate better integration or sound judgment.

findings.definition: Offering reasons grounded in norms or values to defend why an action is acceptable or should be chosen.
findings.novelty_rationale: The outcome includes scored written reasons about academic-integrity scenarios,extending an existing positive/neutral reasoning practice.
findings.evidence_scope: Five scenarios score choices0–2andjustifications0–3,rather than only agreement/intention. Full rubric/keys,sample responses and ICCresults are not in the supplied PDF,so the normative adequacy and coding reliability cannot be independently assessed. No actual ethical behavior or AI-generated justification quality is measured.
findings.boundary: A fluent,principled-sounding reason need not be true or normatively defensible. Check factual premises,applicable rules,conflicting rights and feasible actions;rubric conformity alone does not establish moral correctness.

source_corrections.issue: Individual raw path coverages exceed the displayed overall solution coverage for both high and low outcomes.
source_corrections.reliable_correction: Under the standard same-outcome definition,solution membership is the union/max of path memberships;its coverage cannot be below any included path’s raw coverage. Highraw.877/.824/.811exceedoverall.793;lowraw.712/.675/.644exceedoverall.635. At least labels,values or analysis universes need clarification. Do not invent replacement coverage or treat the printed solution as independently verified.

source_corrections.issue: The cognitive-complexity×guidance coefficient is printed−.077in the diagram,whileTable4andtextreport+.077,p.017.
source_corrections.reliable_correction: Preserve the sign conflict. The positive moderation is the tabular/prose report,not independently verified raw output;the diagram needs clarification. Do not silently flip a raw estimate or claim the visual confirms the direction.

source_corrections.issue: The prose frames low outcomes as absence of guidance/course,while two low paths show peripheral presence of guidance and course is blank/present/blank.
source_corrections.reliable_correction: Interpret each configuration as actually displayed. Low outcomes are not uniformly absence of both inputs;the table cannot support a blanket absence explanation. The broader coverage mismatch remains unresolved.

source_corrections.issue: Methods describe online electronic/offline verbal consent and an exemption basis;final boilerplate is malformed and says written consent.
source_corrections.reliable_correction: The actual consent mode and review/exemption documentation require clarification. Report the methods’ account and the inconsistent boilerplate;do not infer an ethics approval,legal violation or misconduct from this wording alone.

source_corrections.reliable_correction: Treat zero as rounded and the tabular.001as ambiguous bound/formatting,not exact recovered probabilities. Retain the prose’sp<.001report and do not claim original unrounded bootstrap probabilities.

source_identity_checks.finding: The supplied reference identifies Cognitive architectures for artificial intelligence ethics,DOI10.1007/s00146-022-01452-9. Its indexed primary summary is a theoretical argument for AI cognitive architectures,not sufficient verification of the nearby claim that empirical ethics education increases students’ moral cognition. Check the full source before treating it as a completed education intervention.
source_identity_checks.scope: Selected indexed summary/title only,not a full article review or proof that no relevant secondary discussion appears anywhere.

source_identity_checks.finding: Martin/Rubin1995is explicitly a cognitive-flexibility measure;Reynolds2008is moral attentiveness. These source identities do not by themselves validate renaming the adapted scales integrative complexity or stable norm internalization.
source_identity_checks.scope: Titles and adaptation descriptions read in supplied paper;original scale articles not independently read.

methodological_limits: The authors explicitly acknowledge cross-sectional associations,reverse/reciprocal relationships and unobserved confounding. Stronger internalization/causal-path language elsewhere must retain that limit.
Three methods share one dataset;bootstrapping,fsQCAconsistency andIPMAdo not create independent causal evidence.
Full scenario/rubric/item/ICC/calibration appendices are external and unread. Do not claim completed validation or reproduction of task scoring.

Perceived guidance/course experience differs from objective exposure or randomized training. Major,grade,frequency coding and university clustering need more detail before interpreting all adjusted coefficients.
Construct drift between norm internalization,moral issue attention,cognitive flexibility and integrative complexity prevents treating those terms as measured synonyms.
Excluding invalid justifications while allowingzero-rubric responses may select on outcome quality;criteria and separate exclusion counts are needed.
A standard fsQCAcoverage identity fails in the printed table. Different sensitivity thresholds and selected core conditions cannot be treated as universal necessary causes.
IPMApriorities are model-derived,not direct importance preferences or evidence a proposed curriculum/prompt intervention works.

cross_paper_learning.finding: Both use same-sample complementary analyses and adapted self-report constructs. Extra model families do not identify causal mechanisms or remove scale/construct mismatch.
Unlike a willingness-only outcome,this paper scores short choices/reasons. Neither measure establishes actual misconduct,and a rubric requires independent validity and rater evidence.

Reflective norm internalization differs from defending current arrangements as legitimate or using moral cover to rationalize harm. An adopted norm may still be unjust,and technical guidance can be misinterpreted.
Both explicitly acknowledge that significant indirect associations do not establish causal mediation. Different measurements and scenario roles must survive the condensed ontology summary.

deferred.reason: The source’s differentiation/integration definition overlaps existing integrative complexity,and its instrument is adapted cognitive flexibility. Keep provenance/measurement caveats;do not add a vague duplicate.
Broad umbrella inconsistently defined as internalization versus awareness/attention. The two narrower concepts are represented distinctly rather than treated as synonyms.

deferred.term: AI ethical decision-making / normative guidance / ethics course experience
deferred.reason: Context-specific outcome and perceived intervention/exposure descriptions,not three distinct behavioral mechanisms. Preserve proposed test and rubric learning in existing justification/attention concepts.
Frameworks/analysis properties,not demonstrated model behaviors. Printed configurational coverage needs clarification before relying on exact solution claims.

limitations: Original cited books,UNESCOguidance,scale articles and supplemental appendices remain unread. One paper contributes once per relevant concept,no matter how many analyses. No automatic ethical/harm links or invented yearly mention totals.
